outcome.technical: CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]: Added gains three entries (the new `drive-phase.py restore <taskId>` verb with its refusals and exit codes; the triage `--answer leave --fix <ids> --reason`; the executor brief's `Where your files are documented` section). The existing `audit-task start` reader-refusal entry is extended with what the phase narrowed and added: only readers inside the edited region, `scope --files +` answers not asked again, and `--introduces delete:/rename:` asking for importers. Changed gains the four R43 entries: the Co-Authored-By trailer names the model the ledger recorded, the configured text is never written, and --state commits carry none; /audit:worktree task-remove and remove --path refuse a tree with a move's copy beside it, --force included, and the drive and /audit:status name the restore command; a task commit stages the changed paths its own outputs patterns cover; the plan gate no longer opens an edit through a fileIndex row alone. Changed also gains entries for the other shipped behaviour I found by reading git log 531fe6ec..HEAD and each task outcome in P155.json: submit refuses an undeclared edit on the serial path, and scope-changed re-runs the gate before close; the drive runs a ready task before it re-offers a triage or sign-off, drops a member that is no longer ready, and writes the brief for a verb-started task; run-test-gate --task's walk arm and the test-support widening settled by an unscoped declared entry; the red-first helper and test-support modules. A new Fixed section covers: HEAD read one way (empty loose ref, pathspec shapes, start-head tie); the hooks' git-place memo and the same-second arm/revoke; the autocrlf move comparison; a redo undone when the recut setup refuses, plus redo pins dropped; and the kept-tree refusal naming the marker's task. Left out as not shipped to plugin users: the tools/, CI, test-suite and repository-doc tasks (release.py, the plan window, the cost table, ruff over .claude/hooks, prove-gates renames, the AST pins). COMPATIBILITY.md: the coauthor promise was already recorded and is unchanged. Added a 'forced removal of a task tree with a move's copy beside it - and it changed' bullet among the exit-code moves outside the promise (exit 0 -> 1, repair is the restore verb). Added two sentences to the 'what a guard refuses' bullet: require-plan narrowed after 3.7.0, and a fileIndex row alone no longer declares, while the key is still written and read. Judged not a promise question: outputs staging, because no key stops being read and nothing that took effect stops; the commit now carries paths it used to refuse. R44: the schema's meta.commit.coauthor description now says a set value asks for a trailer naming the recorded executor model, that its text is never written, that null or blank writes none, and that record commits carry none. R49: deleted audit-task.py's parenthesis about in_progress_task_map's fileIndex arm. A class grep for the stale claims (`fileIndex. arm|fileIndex arm|re-adds paths`, `Trailer appended|appended to commit messages|end every commit message with`) over the tree, plan records excluded, gave 0 hits after the fix. HOW THE EDITS WERE MADE: CHANGELOG.md and COMPATIBILITY.md went through Edit, which the plan gate allowed. The schema and audit-task.py edits, and three CHANGELOG rewraps, were written by a python3 one-shot through Bash with an asserted single match. No refusal came before those writes and every file is in my declared files, but the Bash route skips the plan gate's per-write check, so I am saying it here. RUNS (all from the task tree): the brief's gate sweep exit 0, '9/9 files ok, 2281 cases'; tests/test__deps.py + tests/test__output_lints.py sweep exit 0, '2/2 files ok, 449 cases'; _output_lints.prose_number_claims() -> [] and _deps.doc_prose_numbers() -> [], run again after the last CHANGELOG edit; tools/prove-gates.py --selftest exit 0 'ALL PASS: 66/66 cases passed'. `sh tools/verify.sh --affected` (affected.py said FULL SET required) exit 1 with one red step: the selftests-stress leg (cp1252 plus a spaced, linked TMPDIR). Only tests/test_drive_phase.py failed there ('808/809', case sd12, redo_left on the serial path, a fixture path containing a space), giving '194/195 files ok, 17492 cases'. The plain selftests slice, the cp1252 slice, the runner, e2e, lint (ruff, vermin, gate-parity, bench-hooks, measure-context), js, manifests (validate-manifest and ajv over the starter, this plan and the example against the edited schema), plugin validate, report and panel all printed ok. drive-phase.py and tests/test_drive_phase.py are not in my files and my diff changes no code, so this is probably not mine; the orchestrator re-runs on a quiet tree. FOUND OUTSIDE MY FILES, not edited: (1) plugins/audit/README.md:461 still says '`fileIndex` is what the plan gate matches an edit against', which is now false. (2) plugins/audit/commands/worktree.md:79-81 and the exit-code line at :170 list task-remove's refusals without the unsettled-tree one, and no user doc (commands/, reference/, README) describes the move's copy or the `drive-phase.py restore` verb, so for now the CHANGELOG is the only user-facing description. (3) hooks/require-plan.py:535's refusal text lists 'no `fileIndex` row' among where it looked; that is accurate for its search but may mislead now that a row does not declare. DEPENDANTS: COMPATIBILITY.md's basename readers (_config.py, the schema, _config_rules, _evidence_io, _ado_conventions, _ado_parent, _areas, _branch): still correct, because I added bullets and sentences and renamed or removed no section they cite. audit-task.py's importers (full-gate, run-test-gate, test__doctor_trail, test__invariants, test__scoped_commit, test_audit_task, test_close_phase, test_commit_task_work) and the names used elsewhere: still correct, comment-only change, and test_audit_task is green in the gate. The schema's path readers (examples/acme-store/audit-plan.json, the starter template, test__manifest_io, check-example-ledgers, prove-gates, verify.sh, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, docs/design/audit-concurrency-report.md): still correct, only one description string changed; validate-manifest, ajv and check-example-ledgers printed ok in the affected run. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md:4161 already describes the coauthor rule as the new schema text does, and :5689 already says in_progress_task_map reads files alone. tests/test_audit_task.py, _config_rules.py, _branch.py, _manifest_vocab.py, test__manifest_phases.py, prove-gates.py, release.py, _harness.py, test__branch.py, test__config_rules.py, test__manifest_vocab.py, test__affected_tests.py, sweep-selftests.py, stamp-verification.py, test__runner_collects.py and test_stamp_verification.py were not edited and are still correct; each suite among them is green in the gate.
